title: Hartshorne-Lichtenbaum top local-cohomology vanishing
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof reduces through completion and maximal-dimensional components to a complete local domain. It then replaces the support ideal by a one-dimensional prime and changes ordinary powers to symbolic powers in a dualizing Ext colimit; the depth of these symbolic quotients forces vanishing. The task requires the duality-and-symbolic-power mechanism rather than ordinary cohomological dimension bounds.
